title: Cross-project Contracts Pointer
notes: Pointer only. Since S3424 (2026-09-24) the pointer set is docs/contracts/<ID>.md, one file per contract id indexed by docs/contracts/README.md, as REPO-LAYOUT rule 2 fixes and the canon check-compliance.ps1 reads; docs/CROSS_PROJECT_CONTRACTS.md is the one-page summary of the same set, and a new contract gets its pointer file and its summary row in one change. Every contract this product exposes to another program - the stream catalog handoff set with its consumer registry, the live broadcast exchange, this product's side of the OCR overlay exchange - and the companion .fmscfg contract it consumes moved out of this repository to the shared contract store on 2026-09-22, so a consumer can read one canonical copy without cloning the producer. The store's own README.md is the index and the change rules. This file names each contract by id, version, home folder and this product's role, and must never restate contract text; the catalog it points into is outside the repository and therefore outside every gate here. Since 2026-09-22 the catalog is organized by function rather than by product, so a citation is by id and section (STREAM-BANK rule 4) and never by path. Since 2026-09-22 this product also OWNS the automated-checks domain (CHECK-VERDICT, CHECK-BASELINE, CHECK-PLACEMENT, BUILD-EVIDENCE): the reporting boundary of an automated check - exit-code vocabulary, verdict line, baseline file shape, placement registry, and when a build or test result is evidence about the shipped artifact. What a check LOOKS FOR stays canon and is not in the catalog; only the channel it reports through is. Since 2026-09-23 this product also OWNS WAVE-PARTICLES (animated-backdrop/): the signature 'particles and lines' animation behind the audio player, the launcher wallpaper, the watch backdrop and the site hero - a change to its speed, geometry or colours is agreed in the catalog before any surface changes. Since 2026-09-23 this product also OWNS the iconography domain (ICON-SET, ICON-RENDER, ICON-EXTERNAL): one glyph and one EN/RU/UK name per meaning across phone, watch, docs and site, the colour roles and themes a glyph obeys, and how third-party marks and downloaded pictures are shown; its glyphs, CATALOG.md and gallery.html are regenerated from this repository by scripts/docs/export-icon-contract.ps1. ICON-SET and ICON-RENDER are at 0.10 since S3433: measured style, three derived looks, palette.json and size tiers.

title: Play Publishing State
notes: Dated record of what Play actually publishes: what the store serves, what each track holds, what Policy status lists, plus the ordered recovery plan and its carrier tickets (S2272). Two of the three blocks are machine-written - scripts/release/refresh-play-publishing-state.ps1 is their only writer and overwrites anything hand-edited between the s2272:measured:* markers, so edit the readers or the refresher instead. The Policy status block is transcribed by the owner and no script can refresh it: the Play Developer API exposes tracks, edits and listings and no policy or rejection surface at all. A row with no measurement date is read as unmeasured, never as unchanged.
